# ADR-NNNN: Title

**Status**: proposed · accepted · superseded · deprecated

**Metadata**: Date · Verification date · Related requirements (SRS §) · Related risks
(`docs/risks/ACTIVE_RISKS.md` IDs)

## Context

What problem or question this decision addresses. Evidence for why it needed a decision at all —
not retroactively invented reasoning.

## Decision

What was decided, stated plainly.

## Consequences

What this decision makes easier, harder, or forecloses. Include real tradeoffs, not just upside.

## Alternatives previously considered

Only include alternatives where there's actual evidence they were considered (a discussion, a
prior implementation, a rejected PR) — do not fabricate a comparison that didn't happen.

## Related requirements

Link SRS sections this decision serves or constrains.

## Related risks

Link `docs/risks/ACTIVE_RISKS.md`/`RISK_ARCHIVE.md` entries this decision created, mitigates, or
is constrained by.

## Verification date

When this ADR's "Status" was last confirmed still accurate against the real, current
implementation — not just when the ADR was written.
